title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
description: Dorothy is swept away by a cyclone to the magical Land of Oz, where she sets off to meet the Wizard with three unforgettable friends. Simple, clear sentences — a perfect first novel in English.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Twelve classic detective stories told by Dr. Watson. Each adventure is self-contained, so one story makes a satisfying weekly challenge unit.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Nick Carraway narrates the glittering, doomed world of Jay Gatsby in 1920s New York. Rich, literary prose for readers who want a challenge.
